inventory.observed: One coordinate frame: vertical axis at approximately x=99 points upward; horizontal axis at approximately y=264 points right. The curve and every guide, endpoint and tick share this frame.

observedLabels.location: upper left of the vertical axis

relationships: The vertical axis extends a little below the horizontal axis.
No numerical values or units are printed on either axis.

inventory.observed: A single thick solid curve falls monotonically from the high red-frequency boundary near x=175,y=55 to the lower violet-frequency boundary near x=492,y=197. Its downward slope progressively flattens.
relationships: The left and right solid vertical endpoint lines join the horizontal axis to the curve.
The curve is confined to the red-to-violet interval, apart from a few pixels of stroke-cap overhang.
No oscillation, numerical extremum or distinct second curve appears.

inventory.observed: Six sampled curve marks, left to right: five hollow rings near x=201,254,305,361,413 and one filled mark near x=465. The last mark has no light center in the displayed full canonical image.
relationships: All six marks lie on the falling solid curve.
Each mark has its own downward dashed vertical guide to the frequency axis.
The five hollow marks precede the one filled mark.
inventory.countDecision: Five hollow plus one filled is a direct pixel observation, not a waiver or acceptance of a historical defect.

inventory.observed: Six dashed vertical guides, under the six sampled marks; five separate intermediate short solid x-axis ticks near x=227,281,337,388,441; two taller solid endpoint boundaries near x=175 and x=492.
relationships: The five short intermediate ticks fall between adjacent sampled guides.
Endpoint boundaries are not intermediate ticks and are not dashed guides.
The source spacings are approximately regular, but no exact numerical frequency step is specified.
The red frequency is lower and left of the violet frequency.
Received energy per time is greater at the red boundary than at the violet boundary.

sourceLimitations: Schematic monochrome graph, not a measured dataset. Pixel positions are observational anchors only and must not become invented physical values.
